notices: RFQ (request-for-quote) reads and writes use v2 only. Writes require auth; rfq-open requires kind; free top-level signature is refused. Quoted answers carry full signed orders. Version 1 RFQs do not appear in version 2 reads. These are covered input/output breaks, not a compatible extension.
Tool names and the exit-code map retain their prior shape. Consumers must migrate required inputs, quoted-answer references and RFQ read expectations using the tagged migration guide.

Tagged nested PermitParams uses (address,uint256,uint256,bytes signature), aligned with Market Registry 0.6.0 and its replacement adapter on both chains. Old-format permit bytes cannot be reused at the replacement adapter. Existing old-adapter orders are not migrated, cancelled or re-signed.

Fixed-rate RFQs and positive canonical uint256 decimal-string rates remain supported. API admission, unsigned order preparation and recipe selection do not establish requester acceptance or end-to-end fillability.

Signature proof mismatch records conflict and relayed=false before relay; missing-key refusal is local. Exit 3 or 4 alone does not prove nothing was sent: upstream errors and venue conflicts share those codes. RFQ relay is off-chain, not on-chain transaction broadcast.
